name: Space Invaders Clone
shortDescription: A polished browser Space Invaders clone with waves, scoring, lives, and classic left-right-shoot gameplay.

improvements.description: Added dynamic enemy speed scaling, dancing animation with two alternating frames, row-specific enemy colors, improved collision detection, progressive wave positioning, and destructible arch-shaped barriers.

Added mobile responsive layout with touch controls (left/right/fire buttons), game over overlay with final score and wave stats, stronger enemy speed scaling for last few enemies, wider bullet collision hitboxes, and removed duplicate shell elements.
